label: common_2120_announce_01
text: Next up is the second round! I’m sure you’re\nready to hear the matchup, so let’s get to it!

label: common_2120_ecology_02
text: I hear you went out on your Treasure Hunt and\nwound up becoming a Champion.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_04
text: I guess I’m the homeroom teacher for two\nChampion Rank students now.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_05
text: I won’t lie—I’m feeling a wee bit of pressure\nhere![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_06
text: I’ve got to work hard so my students don’t\noutshine me too much, huh?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_07
text: Well, then! Let’s get started, shall we?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_announce_04
text: And the winner of this second-round battle is...\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: common_2120_ecology_09
text: Hehe. You beat me! You’re quite the strong\nTrainer, aren’t you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_10
text: You’re more fit for the teaching profession than I\nam with that boundless confidence of yours![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_head_teacher_01
text: Mr. Jacq! Did I hear you correctly just now?![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_11
text: Uh-oh. Uh... Hi, Director. Are you angry with me?\nHehe...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: common_2120_ecology_12
text: Well, I’m going to go get yelled at. Good luck in\nthe coming battles![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
